purpose: Consolidate the provenance of Tim's reported Josh Moon/Moloch material while separating prior Timic symbolism, later Tim recollection, public MATI context, adversarial commentary and the still-missing primary excerpt.

canonical_conclusion.earlier_symbolic_precedence: confirmed at the Tim-corpus level before the July corridor
canonical_conclusion.prophecy_status: prior-symbolic-pattern candidate; not a demonstrated prior-specific prediction
canonical_conclusion.rule: Do not attribute 'sold to Moloch by the government', altar/sacrifice language, occult belief, government affiliation, informant status or literal sacrifice to Josh Moon unless primary evidence is recovered.

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Tim explicitly said that when he spoke of 'MOLOCH' he meant 'them', inside a polarity summarized as Center=soul=seed versus Dog=Circle=consuming your soul and 'they want to take your humanity'.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: Moloch was already an active name for an extractive/anti-center force in Tim's own symbolic system well before the July MATI corridor.
prior_timic_precedence.prediction_weight: precedence only; no Josh-specific future event identified

prior_timic_precedence.recovered: Tim's framework already joined Serpent-Tree, Lucifer, Moloch, Tim's Son, Door/Merkaba, bull/ox/yoke, North-Pole grave, lion, grain of wheat and redemption; the same conversation family also joined son/door, bull-for-milk, black cube/box, footstools, Tree of Life versus Tree of Death and layered Moloch imagery.
prior_timic_precedence.significance: The later Josh/Moloch material entered an already-developed Moloch + Son + Cow/Bull + Cube + Tree symbolic field rather than creating that field after the fact.
prior_timic_precedence.prediction_weight: strong prior-symbolic-pattern evidence; not an event forecast

candidate_explanations.description: A June MATI utterance may exist and have been revived later. Four June MATI recordings and transcript links survive, but no exact Moloch excerpt has yet been recovered.
The underlying remark may be in the July 24 MATI stream and may have reached Tim directly or through the July 27 clipping wave.

Tim's later phrase may combine an underlying personal/family-sacrifice reading with separate government/fed discourse and Tim's already-existing Moloch/sacrifice symbolic vocabulary. This is a provenance hypothesis, not a psychological diagnosis.
A short explicit Moloch clip may have existed but be deleted, poorly indexed or mirrored under an unrelated title.

june_transcript_targets.status: Index exposes machine-readable transcript links; transcript bodies were not retrievable through the current cache layer during the September source pass.

epistemic_rule: Prior symbolic vocabulary can establish precedence and make later convergence historically interesting, but it becomes a prediction only if an earlier statement specifies a later testable event or referent with sufficient precision.
